scope: All 13 original native audit reports, all 54 distinct enforced callback attachments and their reported target rectangles. 74 named PNGs include 13 baseline audit,54 callback,7 localization. Target crops derived without modifying originals.
method: Match report first-unique enforced line order to failure attachment index; Practice raw duplicate lines must not shift LV5 index2.

Inspect originals plus all53 identifiable reported-frame crops at native scale3 (1206x2622 pixels,402x874 points). Four full failing-screen originals checked; crops show actual tab bars occupying many alleged target rectangles.

Callback screenshot follows issue snapshot; it still cannot establish the exact instant/region sampled internally by XCTest. No ICC profile is embedded; RGB core/background samples below are diagnostic corroboration, not a measured full-target minimum or complete WCAG audit.

ordering_conclusion.assessment: Current isolated-kind retries already reproduce most visible contradictions. One fresh-process contrast-first run is a bounded test of state retained by a preceding failed .all; separating kinds in the same process alone is not established remediation.

finite_next_steps: For28 individually visible targets, implement an explicit evidence-linked contrast-only matcher: exact screen plus stable identifier when available; otherwise exact type,label and captured fully-visible target geometry/role. Fail closed when identity or visibility changes. Do not use screen-wide, keyword, or label-only exemption: Songs,Guitar,LV5 collide across targets.

Back those matchers with regressions for actual foreground/background roles, gradients, opacity and cover compositing. Existing test_song_cover_contrast.py primarily guards catalog-number ink; it does not guard every one of these28 roles. Preserve4.5 normal/3 large text applicable criteria and actual image receipt.

For25 occluded targets, add finite scroll-to-clear same-target audit cases (including below-dock song controls and weekdays, and horizontally clipped violin/cover). Preserve the initial reports; recheck unchanged contrast fully visible before proposing a disposition or source recolor.
Retain all6 opaque Practice callbacks using new callback ordinal/detailedDescription diagnostics; no target exemption until identified.
Retain both Songs DynamicType and clippedText incomplete-audit failures; current source already requires all kinds to finish. A contrast disposition cannot resolve these timeouts.

filter_policy_reference.support: Apple explains individually investigated contrast false positives may be filtered by audit kind and element label, optionally type/identifier. This supports precise dispositions, not an automatic approval of a matcher implementation or of obscured/unidentified targets.

native_limits: No new native run/typecheck performed on Windows. No human VoiceOver, language or hardware certification.
Historical b6 review and this008 callback evidence are separate receipts; neither waives older mixed audit failures.
No product recolor, threshold change, broad known exception or source implementation authorized by this review.
